novice_set1.title: Compare focal fixation share in Episode A
novice_set1.prompt: Which record has the greater share of fixation time classified as focal in Episode A?
steps: In Videos, choose dataset {{VIDEO_DATASET_NAME}} (version {{VIDEO_DATASET_VERSION}}).
Choose the exact video {{EPISODE_A_VIDEO_FILENAME}}. Use only participants ajs and emb.
Choose Video with Fixation Marker. This set uses one view at a time; do not open K-Timeline.

Play ajs from {{EPISODE_A_START_TIME}} to {{EPISODE_A_END_TIME}} at {{EPISODE_A_PLAYBACK_SPEED}} playback speed. Inspect fixation markers and the K-Coefficient value from {{K_COEFFICIENT_FIELD_SOURCE}}.
Repeat for emb using the same video, time range, playback speed, and settings.
Treat K>0 as focal, K<0 as ambient, and K=0 as neutral. Compare focal fixation duration divided by total fixation duration; do not compare raw duration alone.
